title: Gigabash Mobile brings arena-brawling action to phones with your favourite giant monsters
summary: Ever since Godzilla was stomping around Tokyo like a big playground, one question has been on everyone's mind: Let them fight. Alright, that's a statement, not a question, but my point stands. Big monsters are cool, so big monster versus big monster is even cooler, and that simple equation is exactly what Passion Republic Games' GigaBash Mobile is the solution to! In GigaBash Mobile, you're dropped into the open arena of a city, and made to fight against your fellow giant monsters to either save or doom humanity. That means duking it out between fully destructible environments, unleashing devastating attacks and generally laying waste to everything around you. ... [MORE]

title: Guild Wars gets its first DLC in 20 years with the announcement of Guild Wars Afterlife
summary: Guild Wars Reforged saw an MMORPG hit fondly remembered by many veteran players finally make a return. But, there's even bigger news on the horizon, as Guild Wars Reforged will also see the debut of the original Guild Wars' first DLC in over 20 years! Guild Wars Afterlife debuts January 13th 2027, with a suite of new content to enjoy. Guild Wars Afterlife offers a pretty stunning change of scenery too, with adventurers stepping through the Mists of Tyria and into the brand-new land of Xotecha. This South American-inspired jungle realm seems to be very different to what players of Guild Wars have experienced so far. ... [MORE]

title: The Spotter: Dig or Die challenges you to do just that in this roguelike tower defence
summary: In the post-apocalypse, everyone dreams of being the sole person to whom it falls to save everyone. Of course, no one anticipates all the work being the messiah requires, especially if it's just sticking in one place, maintaining a radio antenna. And what if that goes down? Well, as The Spotter: Dig or Die demonstrates, things can only get worse. The Spotter: Dig or Die sees you holding out against hordes of mutants on the edge of Las Veganos, awaiting a call from the President that could save the world. But when your station is buried under sand, it becomes a race against time to get things shipshape, while fighting off the hordes of mutants trying to take you down. ... [MORE]

summary: When I say 'roguelike deckbuilder', you say 'how high?' No, you don't actually, but we have another entry in this constantly growing genre to talk about! But like so many others, we've selected this one because it does something a little different. In Diceomancer, you've got cards, dice, and a fishing trip gone badly wrong. Diceomancer, coming to iOS and Android in 2027, puts you in the shoes of a random adventurer planning on a day's fishing. But things quickly take a turn for the worse as you'll need to battle different types of enemies across multiple environments in first-person, turn-based combat. ... [MORE]

title: Hill Climb Racing 2 gives you new adventure tracks, lore and more to celebrate ten years
summary: If you're a fan of wacky, physics-based racers, more than likely you've spent plenty of time with Fingersoft's Hill Climb Racing franchise. Now, you can celebrate ten years of Hill Climb Racing 2, one of their most popular releases, with an entire month of exciting in-game events for you to sink your teeth into, kicking off today! The celebrations in Hill Climb Racing 2 kick off with Adventure Week, which adds two new tracks, The Great Below and The Climb (no prizes for guessing what the gimmick of these tracks is). Shocking week follows right after, and promises both a new event type and 'special anniversary surprises' we're not yet privy to. All this, and a new mode too, but things don't stop there! ... [MORE]

title: Pokémon Go gets Gadget update, giving you easier hands-free collection
summary: While Pokémon Go is always a fun little ritual for those of us who want to get out of the house, sometimes you don't want to spend your time spinning PokéStops or catching Pokémon when you're rushing your way to work. For a long time, the Explorer Gadget has been the solution to that, and now it's getting a major overhaul! The Explorer Gadget will be familiar to all players over level 20 in Pokémon Go, as it's one of the primary 'AFK' tools for gathering rewards while you're out and about. Even with the screen locked, it will spin PokéStops and catch Pokémon. But now, there are additional functions that even let you use it while you have the app open! ... [MORE]

title: The Farmer Was Replaced brings its million-selling coding simulator to iOS and Android
summary: Consider this: a million copies sold of a game where you write code to run a farm. I wouldn’t have bet on that, but The Farmer Was Replaced got there, and it’s out now on iOS and Android with its new DLC, The Miner Was Replaced, thrown in. You write short programs in a Python-like language, hit execute, and a drone does the tilling, planting and harvesting based on whatever you wrote. No levels, just a steady run of unlocks and problems, like merging pumpkins into one giant one or hunting for treasure in a hedge maze. And if you already code, you can skip the basics and go straight to running a fleet of drones. ... [MORE]

It sees the in-game décor getting the starry treatment too. Wild encounters include Clefairy, Staryu, Elgyem and maybe a Rockruff, with Shiny versions possible across the lot. Raids are Pikachu in a sun crown or a moon crown at one star, Espeon in a sun scarf and Umbreon in a moon scarf at three, and Mega Beedrill, Houndoom, Sableye and Manectric at the top. ... [MORE]

summary: Doctor Doom taking over Marvel Contest of Champions’ fighting menu is the most Doom move. The Empire of Doom Saga takeover brings Latverian theming and monthly intro comics, with a motion comic for part one voiced by Matthew Mercer and part two landing in December, when the game turns 12. title: Bills Must Be Paid brings incremental, piggy bank-smashing gameplay to mobile, out now
summary: You know, it's a bit of a sad state of affairs that, while in the past video games gave us the fantasy of being skilled martial artists or world-defending space soldiers, nowadays it's just about making money. Well, at the very least, Bills Must be Paid is almost as visceral as the most violent boomer shooter, as it's now available to buy on iOS and Android! You may remember us covering Bills Must Be Paid a little while ago, but for those who don't, here's a quick primer. In Bills Must Be Paid, you have only one objective: smash piggy banks, get money and pay off your bills. To help you out, you'll be able to gain upgrades such as perks and rings, but watch out because you only have a limited well of stamina to draw from, and after that runs out, it's game over. ... [MORE]

title: Waframe's new Tau expansion announces launch date for this winter
summary: It seems as if many games nowadays are promising major, paradigm-shifting expansions. We saw it with RuneScape: Reignited, a semi-standalone version of the hit MMORPG, to bring in a new wave of players. But whereas Jagex eventually had to backpedal on their planned spinoff ecosystem, Digital Extremes' new Warframe: Tau expansion looks set to be a true game-changer. The core selling point of Warframe: Tau is that this is a new, expansive single-player narrative to jump into, that sees the long-dormant Tau sector opened for exploration. The sector itself was already explored in the Old Peace update, but now you'll be able to see what's happened to it in the aeons since. ... [MORE]

title: Silver Palace, the Belle Époque-style ARPG, sets release date for this winter
summary: With so many ARPGs on storefronts these days, a new one can seem a little redundant. But as the debut entry in the genre from Elementa Games, Silver Palace is already shaping up to be an exciting new release. And soon you'll be able to judge for yourself, as Silver Palace is confirmed to land on December 14th for iOS and Android! Inspired by a mix of Victorian and Belle Époque fashion, Silver Palace is set in a sprawling metropolis called Silvernia, which is undergoing an industrial revolution powered by... you guessed it: Silverium. This means magic and technology intertwine, with brawling melee action accompanied by high-calibre weaponry. ... [MORE]

title: Petit Planet unveils release date for MiHoYo's debut cosy life sim
summary: MiHoYo are stepping out of their comfort zone a bit with the upcoming Petit Planet, a cosy life sim where you take care of your own planetoid. And soon, you'll be able to get your hands on it and give it a go. Petit Planet has been confirmed to launch for iOS and Android on December 4th! Petit Planet sees you take on the role of a Tender, growing and expanding your own mini planetoid. You'll slowly gather a resource called Luca, and when you've created enough, you'll be able to add new life to your planet. title: Death Stranding Odradek shows us how Kojima's hit series might work on mobile
summary: Death Stranding is, for better or for worse, a quintessentially Kojima game. And it's found a lot of success on virtually every platform, including on mobile. But a newly released prototype app exclusive to a recent gallery could show how else the franchise works on mobile, as Death Stranding Odradek hits iOS and Android! Death Stranding Odradek allows visitors to the Azabudai Hills Gallery, which is hosting the 10th anniversary exhibition for Kojima Productions, to complete a delivery mission and experience the world of Death Stranding through AR. Odradek is named for the device worn on Sam's back in Death Stranding, which provides you with in-game information about the terrain and world around you, as well as warning of the presence of dangerous BTs. ... [MORE]

title: Dungeon Splat! proves that clearing monsters from a dungeon is messy business
summary: If there's one stereotype about fantasy adventurers that's true, it's that they mostly have a 'kill first, ask questions never' policy. Have you ever stopped to wonder if you needed to slaughter that group of Orcs hanging around minding their own business? Me neither. And if violently massacring everything in your path is your thing, then Dungeon Splat is for you! Available now on iOS, Dungeon Splat! pits your intrepid adventurer against a winding dungeon full of enemies. Your job? Simply to clear it out in messy, messy fashion. Details are very scarce at the moment, but we know that none other than storied actor Donald Glover of Atlanta and Community fame will be aboard as both executive producer, director, writer and star. Other details, be they plot or other cast members, aren't available, but watch this space for more information. ... [MORE]

title: Batomon Showdown lets you enjoy creature-collecting fun with a roguelike, autobattler twist
summary: As we head towards midday, it seems fitting that we go for something that firmly falls into the middle between two genres in a very interesting way. And that's with Batomon Showdown, the roguelike autobattler that has more than a bit of a similarity to Pokémon about it, available to play right now on iOS and Android! From the creatures to the characters, it's clear that Batomon Showdown is emulating the classic 2D Pokemon games. But rather than offering a throwback to them, as something like Cassette Beasts did, Batomon Showdown instead transforms it into a roguelike autobattler, where synergies and team comp matter more than individual power! ... [MORE]

title: MLB 9 Innings 26's major graphics update makes your favourite players look better than ever
summary: With the Milwaukee Brewers taking home the title of World Series Champions, major league baseball fans across America are likely already missing the excitement of the diamond. But if you are, you can get some of that same energy with MLB 9 Innings 26! Com2Us' hit mobile baseball sim has been going for over a decade at this point, and to mark the date, they're celebrating not just the closing of the latest World Series, but also a massive new graphical overhaul that leaves your favourite players looking better than ever! Even if you're just logging in, you can earn a Supreme-tier player simply by jumping into MLB 9 Innings 26. ... [MORE]

title: Aniimo gets the second chapter of its first season offering you dozens of new Aniimo to catch!
summary: Aniimo, the popular creature-catching and collecting game from Pawprint Studio, has widened its horizons significantly with the introduction of Season One, Part Two. Departure With the Wind: Part Two introduces a host of new content, including new aniimos to collect and new areas of the map to explore! Of course, given that's the name of the game, let's focus on those new Aniimo first! The collection opens up with 51 new additions, including 31 that are entirely new to the game. You can see from the trailer below that this includes some especially quirky additions such as the Bubbeep and Sugarfish. ... [MORE]
